title: Castelion statement
description: A navy band of three short centred statements in big bold cream type, whose bottom edge is a wide elliptical curve dipping into the page colour (shallow on phones, deep on desktop). Each line slides up out of its own mask as it scrolls in.
notes: the band is bg-secondary in a dark scope; the page colour shows below the curve
follows castelion-feature-card seamlessly (same navy); it has no top padding of its own
name: castelion-statement

props.name: lines
props.description: the statements, one entry per desktop line
